fixture: Public registry metadata captured 2026-11-22; no economic observations or private configuration.

pricesBases.label: Annual CPI inflation (%)
pricesBases.description: Annual CPI inflation rate in the selected year.
pricesBases.rankWording: Ranked by lower annual CPI inflation

pricesBases.label: Average annual CPI inflation (%)
pricesBases.description: Arithmetic average of annual CPI inflation rates over S+1 through E. Average annual rate, not total price increase.
pricesBases.rankWording: Ranked by lower average annual CPI inflation

pricesBases.label: Cumulative CPI inflation (%)
pricesBases.description: Compounded total consumer-price increase over S+1 through E. Inflation compounds; annual rates are never summed.
pricesBases.rankWording: Ranked by lower cumulative consumer-price increase

pricesBases.label: Annual CPI index
pricesBases.description: Consumer price index for the selected year, 2010 = 100. Index level, not a currency amount. Primarily for observing change within a country, not for cross-country ranking.

pricesBases.label: Period CPI change (%)
pricesBases.description: Percentage change in the consumer price index between the selected start and end years; not annualized. Lower values mean a smaller increase in consumer prices.
pricesBases.rankWording: Ranked by lower cumulative consumer-price increase

pricesBases.label: Annual GDP-deflator inflation (%)
pricesBases.description: Annual GDP-deflator inflation rate in the selected year.
pricesBases.rankWording: Ranked by lower annual GDP-deflator inflation

pricesBases.label: Average annual GDP-deflator inflation (%)
pricesBases.description: Arithmetic average of annual GDP-deflator inflation rates over S+1 through E.
pricesBases.rankWording: Ranked by lower average annual GDP-deflator inflation

pricesBases.label: Cumulative GDP-deflator inflation (%)
pricesBases.description: Compounded total increase in the GDP implicit price level over S+1 through E.
pricesBases.rankWording: Ranked by lower cumulative GDP-deflator inflation

verified.name: Exports of goods and services (current US$)

tradeBases.label: Annual export value
tradeBases.question: How large was this country’s export flow in the selected year?
tradeBases.rankWording: Ranked by largest annual export value

tradeBases.label: Period export growth — CAGR
tradeBases.question: At what average annual rate did nominal export value grow between the selected endpoints?
tradeBases.rankWording: Ranked by highest nominal export CAGR

tradeBases.label: Period total export flow
tradeBases.question: What was the total nominal value of exports across all years in the selected period?
tradeBases.rankWording: Ranked by largest cumulative export flow

tradeBases.label: Period average annual export flow
tradeBases.question: What was the average annual nominal value of exports during the selected period?
tradeBases.rankWording: Ranked by largest average annual export flow

tradeBases.rankWording: Ranked by largest annual import value

tradeBases.label: Period import growth — CAGR
tradeBases.question: At what average annual rate did nominal import value grow between the selected endpoints?
tradeBases.rankWording: Ranked by highest nominal import CAGR

tradeBases.label: Period total import flow
tradeBases.question: What was the total nominal value of imports across all years in the selected period?
tradeBases.rankWording: Ranked by largest cumulative import flow

tradeBases.label: Period average annual import flow

verified.name: Foreign direct investment, net inflows (BoP, current US$)

capitalBases.label: Annual net FDI
capitalBases.question: How much net FDI entered the economy during the selected year?
capitalBases.rankWording: Ranked by largest annual net FDI inflow

capitalBases.label: Cumulative net FDI
capitalBases.question: How much cumulative net FDI flowed into this economy during the selected period?
capitalBases.rankWording: Ranked by largest cumulative net FDI inflow

capitalBases.label: Average annual net FDI
capitalBases.question: What was the typical annual net FDI inflow during the period?
capitalBases.rankWording: Ranked by largest average annual net FDI inflow

verified.name: Foreign direct investment, net inflows (% of GDP)

capitalBases.label: Annual FDI (% of GDP)
capitalBases.question: How large were net FDI inflows relative to the size of the economy in this year?
capitalBases.rankWording: Ranked by higher net FDI inflows relative to GDP

capitalBases.label: Average annual FDI (% of GDP)
capitalBases.question: What was the typical annual FDI inflow relative to GDP during the period?
capitalBases.rankWording: Ranked by higher average annual FDI relative to GDP

capitalBases.label: Cumulative FDI / cumulative GDP
capitalBases.question: How large was cumulative net FDI relative to cumulative GDP over the same period?
capitalBases.rankWording: Ranked by higher cumulative FDI relative to cumulative GDP

production.subject: exchange
production.label: Official exchange rate — LCU per US$
production.unitLong: local currency units per US$ (period average)

verified.name: Official exchange rate (LCU per US$, period average)

fxBases.label: Annual Official FX Rate
fxBases.question: What was the official annual-average exchange rate (LCU per US$)?
fxBases.note: Not cross-country rankable: LCU magnitudes reflect currency denomination, not strength.

fxBases.label: Annual Nominal FX Change
fxBases.question: How did the official nominal exchange rate move against the USD over the year?
fxBases.rankWording: Ranked by greatest nominal depreciation vs USD
fxBases.note: Positive = nominal depreciation vs USD; negative = nominal appreciation vs USD.

fxBases.label: Period Nominal FX Change
fxBases.question: How did the official nominal exchange rate move against the USD between the selected endpoints?
fxBases.rankWording: Ranked by greatest nominal depreciation vs USD
fxBases.note: Endpoints only (price, not flow). CAGR shown as secondary annualized display with identical ordering.

externalBases.label: Annual CA / GDP

externalBases.rankWording: Ranked by higher current-account balance relative to GDP

externalBases.rankWording: Ranked by higher average annual CA relative to GDP

externalBases.label: Cumulative CA / Cumulative GDP

externalBases.label: Period Reserve-Stock Change

externalBases.rankWording: Ranked by largest reserve-stock percentage change

externalBases.label: Ex-Gold Reserve Import Coverage
externalBases.question: How many months of annual goods-and-services imports do ex-gold reserves cover?
externalBases.rankWording: Ranked by higher ex-gold reserve import coverage

externalBases.label: Annual Remittances Received

externalBases.rankWording: Ranked by largest annual remittance inflow

externalBases.label: Cumulative Remittances Received

externalBases.rankWording: Ranked by largest cumulative remittance inflow

externalBases.label: Average Annual Remittances
externalBases.question: What was the typical annual remittance flow scale during the period?
externalBases.rankWording: Ranked by largest average annual remittance inflow

externalBases.rankWording: Ranked by higher cumulative remittances relative to cumulative GDP
